title: The Banquet
text: A long table laid for exactly as many as you are, down to the last cup. The candles are still warm and the wine is still breathing. Nobody has touched the food. Every chair has been pulled out a little, as if the guests had only just risen to greet you.

options.label: Sit down and eat what was laid for you. It would be rude to refuse such hospitality.

outcomes.text: It is the finest meal any of you have eaten since the rift opened. You sleep deeply afterward, too content to wonder who cooked it.
The meat stirs on the plate. Then the hosts arrive, late and hungry, to join their guests.
Beneath one plate lies a warm ring that fits no finger twice. It hums faintly with essence as you pocket it.

options.label: The most seasoned of you tastes it first, while the rest watch their face.

outcomes.text: The veteran chews slowly, waits, then nods. It is only food after all. The rest eat their fill without mentioning the empty chairs.
The veteran goes grey and very still, then laughs far too long at a joke none of you can hear.

options.label: Push in your chairs and leave the feast to whoever it was truly laid for.

outcomes.text: Something sighs as the door closes behind you. Through the crack beneath it, you watch the candles go out one by one.
